description: Build a nanocalcs.com URL for a tool id with inputs pre-filled via query parameters. Values are validated against the tool's parameter spec (ranges, allowed values, dates); invalid or unknown parameters are rejected with the accepted list. Give the returned url to the user.

locale.description: Page language for links, e.g. en, ko, ja, es, de. Default en; falls back to English when a tool has no page in that language. Available: en, ja, ko, en-IN, id, ar, tr, ms, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, pl, nl, vi, th, zh-CN, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur, fa, uk, ro, cs, hu, el, sv, fil, he, sw, af, ckb, bg, da, nb, ta, zu, kab, sk, az, fi, lv, ne, is, ht, tpi, uz, kk, ky, be, am, sq, ka, sr, km, lo, si, hr, sl, et

name: build_link
title: Build a prefilled nanocalcs link
